messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — ran new quantized embed (heron-lite int6) on short-query holdout; saw ~3.6% recall@10 drop vs fp16. logging here so we can triage.

alex: Repro: `./eval_embed.sh --model heron-lite-int6 --dataset short_holdout --batch-size 32 --seed 42 --metric recall@10`

alex: Raw one-run numbers: fp16: 0.742 | int6: 0.715

chloe: did you try other seeds / batch sizes? microbatch ordering sometimes affects quant rounding noise.

alex: only bs 32/64 so far. seed 42.

sam: quick hypotheses: (1) kv cache/prefix warmup effect with different batch order, (2) quant kernel numeric instability for short sequences.

maria: paste quant config — per-channel/tensor, clamp, scale method?

alex: config: `--quant-mode int6 --per-channel true --clamp linear --symmetric false`

chloe: try bs=1 and bs=128 and compare cosine histograms. also try `--per-channel false` to see sensitivity.

eval-bot: CI artifacts: https://ci.redwood/embeds/1746500002/artifacts (includes cos_hist images, eval_summary.json) :package:

alex: int6 cos mean ~0.81 vs fp16 ~0.83, tails heavier on int6.

sam: heavier tails suggests rounding causing near-neighbor deterioration. cast embeddings to float64 before normalization to rule out post-norm numeric issues.

maria: also run deterministic dataloader: `--shuffle false --num-workers 0 --seed 0`.

alex: re-runs: bs [1,32,128], per-channel false, seeds 1 & 7. results summary:
- bs=1 seed=1: int6 0.734 (fp16 0.742)
- bs=32 seed=1: int6 0.715 (fp16 0.742)
- bs=128 seed=1: int6 0.718 (fp16 0.741)
- bs=32 seed=7: int6 0.719
- per-channel=false bs=32: int6 0.738

chloe: per-channel=false reduces drop — points to per-channel scale noise.

sam: how are per-channel scales computed? running min/max or percentile?

alex: per-channel computed from calibration on 1k samples, using 99.9 percentile.

maria: bump calib to 10k and try pct=99.0.

alex: ran calib-size=10000 pct=99.0 per-channel true bs=32 -> int6 0.735 (fp16 0.742)

chloe: nice, that closes the gap. scale estimation noise was likely amplifying quant error.

sam: recommendation: onboarding defaults — require per-channel calib >=10k or fallback to per-tensor. add CI stability (3 calib seeds, report stddev).

maria: add cosine-delta diagnostic: sample top-1 neighbors in fp16 and report frac that fall below threshold under quant.

alex: PR wip: https://git.redwood/embeddings/pull/983 (adds calib default bump, CI stability check, diagnostic artifact)

chloe: add onboarding checklist note: "per-channel quant => calib-size >=10k or prefer per-tensor"

sam: and mark short-query cohorts (<=16 tokens) as sensitive; include them in holdout by default.

maria: i'll run extended sweep across multilingual short-query + code snippets tomorrow.

alex: thanks — i'll attach artifacts and final summary to PR. :thumbsup:
